question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2e4c89f3c746f6498c22e42732a55c4448921d285b1d1d2006e09d336f44da3.png]
solution:
In Second and fourth dice,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cfeafc5e6a0090fe3206d51a0c963592a263fa3bb0607f81293fffd4417d97f.png] 

Logic: If two dice have the same face value in the given image then their clockwise or anticlockwise wise number are known as opposite numbers in dice.

In the first dice and second dice. The number 3 is common.

The left numbers will be opposite each other writing them clockwise starting from 3.

 
 

 
 
Number

 
 
 
Opposite

 
 
 

 5
 2
 
 

 6
 1
 
 

Here, we can see that the number opposite to 5 is 2.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
